names: Fatty acid esters of ascorbic acid (Ascorbyl palmitate)
display_name: E304 (Fatty acid esters of ascorbic acid)

more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Fatty acid esters of ascorbic acid is used as an antioxidant in food. Its technological role is to slow oxidation in food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat), potato gnocchi, bread prepared solely with the following ingredients: wheat flour, water, yeast or leaven,  salt, pain courant français; friss búzakenyér, fehér és félbarna kenyerek. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
